scalars.spec_text: PREG2 7.4 E4 (Q13): Bonawitz et al. 2017 with the SecAgg+ k-regular option (Bell et al. 2020); cryptography simulated, sizes counted at real values; fixed-point mod 2^32 with a common scale from the clip bound; dropout p in {0, 0.1, 0.3}, n = 64, threshold ceil(2n/3); metrics: bytes per client per round (overhead ratio), communication rounds, unmasking CPU time, success under dropout; criterion: the decoded sum is bit-identical to the plain fixed-point sum. Quality TOST on CALIB and optional MAIN s2026 (Q13): NOT RUN.

disclosures.D-a: Phase-2 hypotheses were generated after the Phase-1 VALIDATION read; arms were selected on CALIB; everything was locked before any TEST value existed.
disclosures.D-b: CALIB selection data are a subset of the MAIN users and of the VALIDATION window that was read.
disclosures.D-c: θ_pre is one seed (no second seed was run). The PRE recipe was not re-tuned at its scale (Phase-1 note 3).
disclosures.D-d: C_FULL differs from PRE in size and recipe. C2 (if run) is the matched reference.
disclosures.D-e: Central DP trusts the aggregator. SecAgg is simulated (costs counted, cryptography not executed). DP-FTRL / LDP are the untrusted-server variants.
disclosures.D-f: Device numbers come from the listed devices only. On-device training cost is a PC proxy unless stated otherwise.
disclosures.D-g: RETRO_TEST was inspected at period level by earlier v1 campaigns (Phase-1 E12(d)).
disclosures.D-h: Phase 2 can confirm a gain ≥ ≈ 0.0005 MRR@20 or equivalence within ±0.0005; a true gain between them is likely to read INCONCLUSIVE.
disclosures.D-i: The DP arms keep T = 384 and the registered z. A small-step recipe over 384 rounds may move θ little; that is the registered mechanism's answer, not a defect to tune away.
disclosures.D-j: Futility uses CALIB headroom (32,768 users); MAIN has 131,072 users, so FUTILITY_SKIP_WB_WC may under-read the headroom available on MAIN.
disclosures.D-k: The Phase-1 TEST result was held for the Phase-2 runs (owner decision, DL 406). No Phase-1 arm, contrast or rule changed.

labels.multiplicity_statement: 14 pre-registered Phase-2 contrast items (Q1-Q9, Q11, Q12a, Q12b, Q13, Q14) plus the derived Q10; primary = Q1 alone, read unadjusted at alpha 0.05, outside Holm; Holm step-down at alpha 0.05 over the secondary family Q2-Q7 (+Q8 only if owner O3 = yes; else Q8 is removed before the lock and the family is Q2-Q7); tertiary unadjusted with a DESCRIPTIVE Holm band; unadjusted 95% paired user-bootstrap percentile CIs (1,000 resamples, seed 20261004) for every contrast; Q1 equivalence and Q13 by TOST on the 90% CI; TEST2 replication is a separate family; never pooled with the Phase-1 family (ALL_METHODS_LOCK 04a3cd19); algebraic dependencies are not independent evidence; every other number is DESCRIPTIVE.
labels.post_validation_rule: Phase-2 arms on MAIN VALIDATION are POST_VALIDATION_EXPLORATORY; Phase-2 selection uses CALIB only; Q1-Q8 on RETRO_TEST are CONFIRMATORY_P2 (PREREGISTERED_FOLLOWUP) with disclosure D-a; Q9-Q14 are TERTIARY_P2; the Phase-1 post_validation_rule of ALL_METHODS_LOCK is unchanged and Phase-2 items never enter the Phase-1 registry.

q1_reading.D-h: Phase 2 can confirm a gain ≥ ≈ 0.0005 MRR@20 or equivalence within ±0.0005; a true gain between them is likely to read INCONCLUSIVE.
q1_reading.rule: PREG2 §9.4 (registered): SUCCESS iff the Q1 95% CI lower bound > 0 and both per-seed points > 0; EQUIVALENT iff the Q1 90% paired user-bootstrap percentile CI lies inside ±0.0005 MRR@20 (TOST, alpha 0.05; the practical-relevance margin, distinct from the CALIB tie band 0.001); FAILURE iff the 95% CI upper bound < 0; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. Precedence when several hold: the listed order (SUCCESS, EQUIVALENT, FAILURE); every condition that holds is recorded in conditions_true.
